tutorial-steps: Create a room and add everyone who will be playing.
Choose a host and select Start game.
Share the link. Everyone finds their name and selects Play, on a phone, tablet or computer.
The host draws the numbers. If a number is on your card, select it to mark it.
Open the card options to choose a background for the empty cells.
